teaser: "You're the one who just decides, aren't you?" someone says, watching you close a deal before the meeting officially starts. Life path 8 and ESTP meet in that moment: the number asks for command of the material world, money, authority, the long climb toward power used well; the type moves by instinct, reading an opening and taking it before the room has finished talking. This crossing makes a mover, not a planner. The pull between them shows early, when the fast read and the long game arrive at the same table and neither one waits for the other to finish.
excerpt: Keys already in hand, coat half on, you are saying the plan for the weekend before your partner has finished asking about it.
